source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Exodus 22:1 maps to Hebrew Exod 21:37; public 22:2–31 maps to Hebrew 22:1–30. Chapters 21, 23, and 24 otherwise align.

key_decisions.decision: Binds public verse to Hebrew 21:37; preserves 5/4 distinction and seh species breadth.
Makes ambiguous pronoun’s referent explicit as striker in bloodguilt clause; breaking-in covers tunneling image noted selectively.
Retains daylight distinction, pronoun openness and forced sale rather than replacing restitution with prison.
Chooses grazing sense of baar and clarifies liable owner’s best produce; exact qere record remains bound.
Retains God reading of ha-elohim, judicial determination and property seizure idiom; judges alternative explained.
Keeps full property list and terse deictic claim; before-God passive leaves human judicial mediation possible, with plural Hebrew verb noted.
Makes keeper and owner distinct, retaining oath and no-payment result for this case.
Chooses hired animal and rental coverage reading of terse clause; terse Hebrew clause and limited certainty acknowledged in note.
Retains seduction, virginity, unbetrothed status and marriage payment without asserting her consent or changing this into the differently worded rape law.
Preserves father’s refusal and continuing payment obligation without supplying the woman’s absent speech.
Preserves female form and lethal prohibition without softening or extending it to modern categories.
Makes lies-with sexual sense explicit and retains death sanction.
Preserves herem technical destruction formula and exclusive recipient rather than a vague exclusion.
Keeps divine lethal agency and matching reversal of protected family conditions without moralizing commentary.
Preserves poor member scope and broad interest prohibition, not merely excessive interest.
Chooses God for elohim with judges alternative noted; preserves parallel divine and human objects.
Unfolds fullness and tears as produce and liquid yield, noting obscure wording; retains firstborn sons without importing redemption procedure here.
Retains holy identity, field-torn carcass prohibition and dog disposal, without recasting as general dietary advice.
